## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is independently reviewable and leaves the project runnable.
- [ ] Active operations remain authorization-bound and fail closed.
- [ ] Sensitive local-only data is not uploaded or logged.
- [ ] Tests use only safe fixtures or explicitly authorized lab targets.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Documentation, status, decisions, and ledger are current.
